I am a researcher interested in freshwater ecology, phytoplankton dynamics and functioning,
ecological modelling and data science in general. I currently work at the [Balaton Limnological Research Institute](https://www.blki.hun-ren.hu/en).

See my profile on:

* [my employer's homepage](https://www.blki.hun-ren.hu/en/node/15734)
* [LinkedIn](https://linkedin.com/in/karoly-palffy-81a82390)
* [GitHub](https://github.com/k-palffy)
* [Google Scholar](https://scholar.google.hu/citations?hl=hu&pli=1&user=Sjzm38EAAAAJ)
* [ORCID](https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2015-7972)
* [ResearchGate](https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Karoly-Palffy)
